title: Azerbaijan Democratic Republic
capsule: The Azerbaijan Democratic Republic (Azərbaycan Xalq Cümhuriyyəti), proclaimed in May 1918 with its capital at Ganja and then Baku, was the first secular democratic republic in the Muslim world and extended the vote to women ahead of many Western states. Arising from the collapse of the Russian Empire and the short-lived Transcaucasian federation, it was beset by the Armenian–Azerbaijani conflict over Karabakh and Zangezur and by foreign intervention before the Soviet 11th Red Army occupied Baku in April 1920 and absorbed it into Soviet Azerbaijan.
